events.action: Callie 把贴在肘内侧的棉花球扯下来塞进包里；她觉得把棉花球扔进咖啡店的垃圾桶不太对劲
objects: cotton wool (taped to inside of her elbow)
events.quote: Callie quickly pulled the cotton wool that had been taped to the inside of her elbow off and put it in her bag.

events.action: 交代这趟抽血/量体重/量身高是由社区助产士做的（社区助产士给她抽了血、称了体重、量了身高）
events.quote: She’d had blood taken, been weighed and had her height measured by a community midwife.

events.action: Callie 出门前在沙发上画了整整一个小时的瓷娃娃头涂鸦，第二天早上这个给 Eulalia 的项目就会消失；她为此感到如释重负
events.quote: This project for Eulalia had come from nowhere, wreaked havoc for an intense week and then after tomorrow morning would be gone again. She was glad of its transience.

events.action: Callie 在咖啡店听见两个女人谈丢失的内裤；Callie 插话建议她们报警，随后觉得自己的多管闲事很傻，提前离开
events.quote: ‘Sorry to interrupt, but I couldn’t help but overhear. You should report that.’ … ‘Maybe,’ Callie said, feeling silly all of a sudden. ‘Sorry again, enjoy your coffee.’

events.action: 楼上的女邻居（Callie 与 Caius 父母的房客）警告 Callie 夜里附近有可疑男子出没（她比口型说出 flasher）；Callie 回家后锁上门链
events.quote: ‘There have been reports of a creepy guy at night round the neighbourhood.’ She mouthed the word ‘flasher’.

events.action: Callie 发消息告诉 Caius 她刚听到的事；姜茶没能压住孕吐，她躺到沙发上继续摆弄情绪板（mood boards）
events.quote: The ginger tea hadn’t fully suppressed the nausea – it was possibly just a placebo, an idea she refused to entertain lest her self-awareness make it fail – but if she was lying down then she could sort of work.

events.action: 门铃响，快递员送花束并要 Callie 签名；Callie 猜花可能来自父亲（Caius 本周已经送过一束）；打开卡片
events.quote: ‘Calliope Foster,’ the delivery man asked. … Callie thought they were perhaps from her father. Caius had already sent her a bunch that week. She opened the card.

events.action: 卡片写着 “Dear Cal, I had such a great time. E x”；Callie 拍下卡片与花发给 Caius，并说时间上有点奇怪、也怀疑是不是早发了一天；Caius 的消息一直只有「一个勾」（未读回执），她生气；她打开 Radio 4 播 Christine de Pizan 与《City of Ladies》的节目来忘掉这件事
events.quote: ‘This is a bit weird right? I’d understand her sending this tomorrow afternoon once the project is finished but this is intense.’ … ‘Maybe it was sent a day too early?’ … Her message was left on one tick. Caius’s frequent unavailability was usually something she just accepted but today it pissed her off. She put on another Radio 4 programme on Christine de Pizan and her City of Ladies and tried to forget about it.
